Listen and complete the conversation with the phrases and responses.

Burak: You’ll never guess who I saw last night!

Teresa: Who?

Burak: My old flatmate, Paco! Remember I used to live with him in a little flat in the city centre?

Teresa: Really? You’re kidding! I thought he was living in Chile.

Burak: Well, he was! But now he lives round the corner! It turns out that he was going to the same concert as me.
